editorial:
Imagine your favorite spooky witches swapping Halloween for the holidays, and you get a wild ride that feels like a giant Christmas party gone wrong. You follow the three sisters as they try to steal young Kevin's soul to stay young forever, but they are also desperate to get back to Salem. The whole thing feels bright, loud, and super funny, blending that classic spooky magic with festive holiday cheer. It is the kind of movie you put on when you just want to relax and laugh at some magical mayhem.

The acting is top-notch, and the chemistry between the witches makes every scene pop. While the plot gets a bit messy in the middle, the funny interactions with Santa and Mrs. Claus keep things moving fast. You will love the colorful costumes and the silly gags, though some of the magic effects look a bit dated.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Kevin tricks the witches into using a reversed spell that accidentally binds them to Santa's sleigh. Instead of stealing his soul, the witches end up losing their youth and turning into harmless kittens. Santa uses his magic to send them back to Salem in their new forms. The movie wraps up with the town celebrating a peaceful Christmas, while the witches are stuck as pets in the past.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves spooky comedies and Christmas movies.
